articles.title: Xiaomi Brings 5000mAh Ultra-Thin Magnetic Powerbank To India
articles.description: Xiaomi has officially expanded its tech ecosystem in India as it brings its globally available of Ultra-Thin 5,000mAh Power Bank to the country. Built for users who demand extreme portability without compromising on performance, this sleek accessory measures just 6mm in thickness and weighs approximately 98 grams, making it easy to carry and store. Constructed using high-density silicon-carbon cell technology wrapped in a premium metallic finish, the power bank claims exceptional durability. It supports up to 15W magnetic wireless charging and up to 22.5W wired fast charging through a versatile two-way USB Type-C port. For thermal management, Xiaomi has integrated an internal graphite sheet paired with multi-layer circuit protection to maintain low operating temperatures and keep connected Android or iOS devices safe during rapid power transfers. Take a look at how it compares against the super-thin iPhone Air. Will this ultra-slim charger be your next daily carry accessory? Let us know your thoughts in the comments. Follow Business Today TV for more.
